name: e621
about: Content from e621 (or e926) through the site's official API, kept as a comic: a pool, one archive of pages, carrying on from the posts already taken.

setup.label: e621 username
setup.help: The account to log in as, for every e621 comic. Needed with the API key for posts the site hides from visitors.

setup.label: API key
setup.help: From the account's profile page, under Manage API Access.

setup.label: User-Agent
setup.help: What the site is told is asking. {username} is replaced with the username above. The site blocks generic agents, so keep it specific.

fields.label: Pool address
fields.help: The pool's page. An e926.net address keeps to safe posts.

fields.label: Skip videos and Flash
fields.help: Leave out webm, mp4 and swf posts. They are fetched by default: the comic's folder keeps each one, the reader plays it, and its archive holds a stand-in page. Needs a ZC-ComicUpdater that takes in videos and Flash from plugins; an older one drops them, and they are fetched again every run.

fields.label: Keep checking an inactive pool
fields.help: An inactive pool is always taken the first time, and the comic marked ended once every post in it is taken. Tick this to never mark it ended and keep looking for changes.
